description: Overview Quote Image Maker is an AI-powered tool for turning quotes, affirmations, captions, and short text into beautiful shareable images. It is built for creators, bloggers, marketers, and social media managers who want to create polished quote graphics quickly without using complicated design software. Key Features - Turn quotes and affirmations into ready-to-share images - Generate backgrounds with AI - Choose from a built-in background library - Upload custom background images - Adjust tex
